description:
Callouts on YOUR CabalSpy ID instance, newest first: users call a token and
    CabalSpy stamps the price and market cap and tracks it. Without filters the
    latest callouts of your platform; with chain + mint the callouts of one token
    ("Who called this token and how did it do?"); with external_id or csid_id the
    callouts of one user. Each entry: token, author (your user id), called_at,
    market cap at the call, now_x and peak_x (multiples since the call), score_x
    (the peak multiple the callout is scored by) and the tracking phase
    (first_day: every minute for 24 h, then scored on candles; extended: every
    5 minutes while active; stopped: after 24 h in a row below a $10k market cap).

    Callouts are an extra switched on per instance on request; otherwise this
    returns feature_not_enabled. Needs your own CabalSpy API key with a CabalSpy
    ID instance (no demo).

chain.description: Only callouts on this blockchain: solana, bnb, base, eth or rh. Required together with mint. Leave empty for all chains.
chain.title: Chain

csid_id.description: Only this user: their CabalSpy ID user id (UUID), for users who signed in with CabalSpy ID themselves. Pass external_id or csid_id, not both.
csid_id.title: Csid Id

cursor.description: Pagination cursor taken from the previous response. Leave empty for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

external_id.description: Only this user: their id on YOUR platform (external_id), as passed when the user was created or imported. Pass external_id or csid_id, not both.
external_id.title: External Id

instance.description: Your CabalSpy ID instance (its client_id, e.g. 'csid_1a2b…'). Only needed when your account has several instances. Leave empty otherwise.
instance.title: Instance

mint.description: Only callouts of this token (mint on Solana, contract on EVM); needs chain. Answers 'who called this token and how did it do'.
mint.title: Mint

name: csid_callouts
